tensions.body: Supplier renewals reach Vendor Steward too late to act on. Now the renewal date is visible only in each supplier's contract, so it surfaces when the invoice arrives; it could be visible to the role at least 60 days ahead. On 2026-09-02 the storage supplier auto-renewed for a year at a 20% higher rate because the invoice was the first sign of the renewal. This touches the role's accountability for tracking supplier renewals and their dates.
Supplier onboarding is slow. It takes much longer than it should to bring a new supplier on, and it feels like this keeps happening. It affects the role's accountability for onboarding new suppliers.

Work sequencing across the circle is invisible. Now the order of committed work exists only in Delivery Coordination's notes, so on 2026-09-18 two roles started the same request in parallel; it could be visible to every role in the circle. Also, the circle's weekly tactical meeting keeps running over time, and on 2026-09-21 it ended 40 minutes late with three agenda items untouched.
Add a Queue Keeper role. Give it the accountability for publishing the circle's work queue every Monday, and a domain over the queue board.
